12V powers a 40 LED device (Bought off the shelf). Contact #1 is a NO PushButton to enable the system, thermocouple if below a set temperature will close the other contact which will enable the heating coil on the far right side.

Modifications i would do to your circuirt are as follows. Your on/off NO contact should go straight after your supply followed by the contact for the termocouple. Then your LED and element at the end. Your switch contacts will have to be rated to handle the full running current of your element. The thermocouple controller wiring depends on what sort of controller you use. You only need a single relay contact and terminals for your thermocouple. There are a few different types of thermocouples eg J, and K type have a read and see which ones suit your needs and controller.
